description: Synthetic college tech-fest committee chat; the outgoing treasurer hands over. English, Indian context. Pseudonymised and masked as stored by Baton.

messages.body: Hi all, creating this group for the fest finance work

messages.author: [PERSON_2]
messages.body: great 👍

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: We decided to keep the registration fee at ₹200 per student for all events

messages.author: [PERSON_3]
messages.body: lol the canteen samosa is back

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: [PERSON_2] is in charge of the sponsor money and the bank deposits from now on

messages.body: ok noted

messages.body: Sponsorship invoices must be sent to all three sponsors by 15 August, otherwise the payment gets delayed to next quarter

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: I'll transfer the sound advance on Friday once the dean signs the approval form

messages.body: good morning everyone

messages.author: [PERSON_2]
messages.body: no idea, ask around

messages.author: [PERSON_1]

messages.author: [PERSON_3]
messages.body: haha ok

messages.body: Sponsor 2 said they will pay only after the fest, not before

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: That contradicts what they wrote in the MoU, the MoU says 50% before the fest

messages.author: [PERSON_3]
messages.body: Who will collect the cash from the help desk every evening?

messages.author: [PERSON_2]
messages.body: gn

messages.author: [PERSON_1]
messages.body: Budget for the food stalls is capped at ₹40,000 total, decided with the faculty advisor

messages.author: [PERSON_3]
messages.body: sounds fine
